translation.name: Seongsu Yeonmujang-gil
translation.summary: A lively Seongsu street where former factory spaces, boutiques, cafes and pop-up stores mix with the neighborhood's industrial character.
translation.description: Yeonmujang-gil is one of Seongsu's main walking streets. Old industrial buildings and shoe-factory traces sit alongside fashion stores, cafes, galleries and frequently changing brand pop-ups. It works well as a central axis for exploring Seongsu on foot.
translation.local_tip: Start near Seongsu Station and explore the side streets as well as the main road. Pop-up schedules change often, so check current listings before visiting.
